description: Search the Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ad Library, Meta's public ad-transparency archive, by keyword or advertiser page ID and country: advertiser, ad text, creative format, landing page, platforms, start/end dates, active status, and spend/impression ranges where Meta publishes them. Up to 20 ads per call. Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller); cached up to 6 h. Price 0.02 USD per call via x402.

adType.description: Ad category (special categories need a country; US is used if ALL)

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country where ads were shown (DK, SE, DE...) or ALL (default)

exactPhrase.description: Match keywords as an exact phrase

keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword searches (ad text / advertiser), up to 3. Required unless pageIds is set.

languages.description: Comma-separated two-letter ad languages, up to 5 (e.g. da,en)

pageIds.description: Comma-separated numeric Facebook page IDs of advertisers (all their ads). Total searches (keywords + pageIds) max 3.

platforms.description: Comma-separated subset of facebook, instagram, audience_network, messenger, threads

name: meta_ads
